description: Effective Docker configuration for running containers observed by the managed host. Application security, daemon exposure and external reachability require separate assessment.
coverage: Explicit capability drop and no-new-privileges configuration

rules.explanation: Run application containers without privileged mode
rules.impact: Requires a reviewed Compose configuration and replacement of affected instances. Workloads needing host privileges require explicit review.

rules.explanation: Use a read-only root filesystem with explicit writable data mounts
rules.impact: Applications writing to the root filesystem require explicit data or temporary mounts before deployment.

rules.explanation: Prevent container processes gaining new privileges
rules.impact: Setuid-dependent workloads may stop working; validate replacement containers and application health.
